title: Scalable Acceleration of Many-Body Quantum Dynamics via Time-Rescaling
summary: Fast quantum control is essential to overcome decoherence in contemporary quantum platforms, yet achieving this in many-body systems remains a major challenge. We show that the time-rescaling (TR) method enables efficient acceleration of closed many-body quantum dynamics, extending its applicability beyond previously studied regimes.
